title: Foundations
summary: The platform everything else builds on: repository, local development, CI, Azure infrastructure, API skeleton, data model, iOS skeleton, sign-in, languages, activity log, knowledge base pipeline, shared services (weather, media, notifications, background worker, AI layer, search) and account deletion and export. Offline sync is a good-to-have feature built on top of a data model designed for it from day one.

acceptance: Repo has backend/, ios/, android/, content/, infra/, docs/ folders as in PLAN.md §5
.NET solution builds with Api, Domain, Infrastructure, Worker and test projects
README explains how to build and run each part
Code style rules (.editorconfig) are enforced on build

title: Commercial readiness
summary: Everything needed before the app is sold to the public: subscriptions, data licences, expert content review, professional illustrations, and legal and store preparation. Future improvement only.

features.title: Freemium subscriptions
features.story: As the owner, I want App Store and Play subscriptions with free and premium tiers so that the app can earn money when it goes commercial.
acceptance: Premium tier unlocks AI features
Server-side receipt validation for App Store and Google Play
Usage limits follow the tier
Users can manage or cancel their subscription

features.title: Commercial data licences
features.story: As the owner, I want commercial licences for all data sources so that the app can legally be sold.
acceptance: Open-Meteo paid plan or an alternative weather provider in place
IPMA and MeteoAlarm reuse terms checked
SoilGrids attribution shown
Any plant-ID service licensed for commercial use

features.title: Expert review of guides
features.story: As the owner, I want an agronomist to review all guides so that the advice is correct before selling the app.
acceptance: Every guide reviewed by a qualified expert
Review date and reviewer recorded on each guide
Corrections merged through the content pipeline

features.title: Commissioned illustrator
features.story: As the owner, I want professional illustrations so that the app looks polished for paying users.
acceptance: Consistent illustration style guide agreed
Key guides and tools illustrated
Images licensed for commercial use

features.title: Privacy policy, GDPR, store listings
features.story: As the owner, I want the legal and store preparation done so that the app can be published publicly.
acceptance: Privacy policy and terms published
GDPR review completed (data processing, retention, consent)
AI disclaimers shown, especially around chemicals
App Store and Google Play listings with screenshots in pt-PT and en
